disambiguation: Not a CLI coding agent or background automation tool; it is a chat assistant that works only inside Obsidian.
extras: README warns the plugin is still evolving and recommends trying it in a test vault with regular backups. Requires Obsidian 1.5.0+; Keychain secret storage needs Obsidian 1.11.4+. Detailed logging requires per-session confirmation and rotates at 1024 KiB.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to chat with language models about your vault and apply their suggested note changes with per-tool approval and rollback.
